summary: Reservation for Scheduled Tribes in Chandigarh UT; no Presidential Order under Art.342 for STs in Chandigarh; migration from Rajasthan (where ST recognized); reliance on Ministry letters permitting ST benefits from native state; precedent from Abhinav Dipakbhai Patel (2019) on migrant rights; Art.342 applicability limited to ST recognition within specific jurisdictions; HC affirmed trial court's decree for allotment despite lack of local ST notification; no binding precedent against migrant ST claims in UTs.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; dismissal of respondent's claim restored based on lack of Presidential Order for STs in Chandigarh UT under Art.342.
case_number: 2024 INSC 119; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP(C) No.1663/2019)
